status: development (O'Neil 2016 is exposed; nothing here is confirmatory)
disclosure_before_writing: O'Neil library built at 17:37: 22,737 experiments, 38 drugs, 39 lines, hit rate 0.0329 (749 hits), pair/line/drug hit-rate spreads, label quantiles, batch-3 reproducibility (315 shared experiments, r=0.62, 45% of primary hits re-call).
The first seven combination rows (5-FU & ABT-888 in A2058) were printed while inspecting the workbook.
No arm has been run. NCI-ALMANAC: only the CSV header, the field documentation and compound names were read.
label: Bliss excess (pp) averaged over the experiment's combination dose grid; hit = label > 10 (SynergyFinder convention). O'Neil: expected = min(rA,1)*min(rB,1) on X/X0 with singles interpolated in log concentration, same batch. ALMANAC: NCI SCORE averaged over all combination records.

scenario.name: transfer to a new cell line
scenario.unit: target cell line (one campaign per line)
scenario.history: every measured combination in the other lines of the same screen
scenario.context: single-agent responses of every drug in every line
scenario.budget: ceil(0.10 x candidates in the target line)
terminal_variants: exploit: buy the top final batch
certify: buy a uniformly random final batch from the top kappa x batch shortlist and certify the untested remainder

arms.random: zero arm: uniform random purchases (predicts no structure)
arms.heuristic_potency: fixed rule: sum of single-agent mean inhibitions
arms.heuristic_headroom: fixed rule: min single-agent inhibition x (1 - Bliss-expected inhibition)
arms.history: static retrieval: pair's shrunk mean label in other lines
arms.wm_static: world model prior only (history + cell-state context), no feedback, P(hit)
arms.wm_full: world model with in-context feedback, P(hit) acquisition
arms.wm_greedy: wm_full ranked by posterior mean (uncertainty ablation)
arms.wm_nocontext: feedback, but no cell-state features or similarities
arms.wm_shuffled: wm_full with cell-state context permuted (seeded control)

endpoints.discovery: measured hits within the budget (per line; summed and paired across lines)
endpoints.certification: realised FDP of certified nominations (mean over lines x audit draws) against alpha; nominations per line; yield-bound coverage against 1 - delta
endpoints.naive_claims: realised FDP of the model-trusting Bayesian-FDR selection; claimed / realised remainder hits
endpoints.price_of_certification: exploit hits minus certify hits, same arm
endpoints.cost: experiments, dose points, wells (O'Neil: 4 replicate wells per point), days; provider spend reported separately

development_choices_allowed: which heuristic is the named fixed-rule comparator
world-model feature set and drug-similarity term
whether an LLM planner arm is carried into the confirmatory protocol
confirmatory_rule: Every choice above is frozen, hashed and written into protocol/confirmatory.json before NCI-ALMANAC outcomes are read through screens.open_vault; the vault is opened once.
